mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.7% compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy environment supports asset valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.7%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 12-month CPI increase exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which reduces equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL 12m % change exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 1% from their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve is likely to implement monetary easing, which supports equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (relative to 2017=100) signals a manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate earnings growth and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200 thousand units signals a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1200, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production level above 105 (relative to 2017=100) indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 105, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.8% with a 0.3 percentage point increase over the past 3 months signals labor market deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as economic growth slows.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
